product_one_liner.value: SER Group’s Doxis platform helps enterprises classify, extract, understand and centrally manage documents while automating workflows and supporting compliance.

pricing_page.notes: The page describes subscription and unlimited-license options and Business, Enterprise and Unlimited cloud editions, without numeric prices.

employee_band.notes: No permitted band fits: the company reports more than 900 employees on https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index contains business-use guides and product content, not two identifiable engineer-authored posts explaining how Doxis itself is built.

public_docs.notes: Public Doxis AI.dp documentation includes integration, model-building, flow-building, API and SDK material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Full Stack AI Engineer is listed on the official careers page; its posting includes AI-model development responsibilities and an Apply now link.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Anthropic through customer-configurable integrations in Doxis AI.dp.
model_provider.notes: These are documented bring-your-own-provider options, not a claim that one provider is the default.

compliance_certs.notes: The certification page explicitly claims all three; SOC 2 applies to Doxis Cloud Services.

last_funding.notes: TA Associates’ strategic growth investment was announced March 21, 2024. The amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified investment was announced March 21, 2024, before the window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying title appears on the main careers index. The checked BDR postings and Account Executive application page explicitly indicate that applications are closed.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 17, 2026, Doxis announced Ask Doxi, Agent Manager and enhanced Superhuman Search.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement states that Andy Spence joined as Chief Revenue Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The published BDR description instructs staff to log activities in “our CRM (Pipedrive)”; this is a stack signal, not evidence that the vacancy remains open.
